Sample.evidence_source: [/page/1/Text/14] A comparison of the 22 participants who completed the study and the 8 who did not revealed no significant differences on Time 1 measures, with the exception of the Reading Ability measure, r(28) = 2.68, p < .05.

IPT.evidence_source: The intervention described is "bibliotherapy" which is a form of CBT.

dxgive.evidence_source: [/page/1/Text/15] We compared the immediate-treatment and delayed-treatment conditions on age, gender, race, reading comprehension, and initial levels of depressive symptoms to determine if there were any significant differences between the two conditions before treatment.

Source.evidence_source: [/page/2/Text/4] Note. PIAT-R = Peabody Individual Achievement Test—Revised; HRSD = Hamilton Rating Scale for Depression; CDI = Child Depression Inventory; CBCL-D = Child Behavior Checklist—Depression. [/page/1/Text/16] The dependent variables were the HRSD, the CDI, the CBCL-D, the DAS, and the ATQ.
